name: The Social Network: LA
overview: Social media is now outstripping traditional media in terms of influence, relevance and reach. But who are the forces behind social media, who are influencing tomorrow's generations? In this new series, we'll take a look at what drives the drivers of social media. Digital pioneer Destorm Power and his friends will show us the ins and outs of the business, while giving us an exclusive look at how they juggle life, work, and relationships - and move the world forward one click at a time.
